title: The study of intestinal toxicity induced by gossypol acetic acid and the mechanism using zebrafish model and network toxicology.
authors: Zhao, Hanxue; Wang, Yuxin; Zhang, Guoliang; Jing, Yudi; Li, Fangzhen; Chen, Xiqiang; Liu, Kechun; Chen, Guiling; Wang, Rongchun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究棉酚乙酸在斑马鱼模型中的肠道毒性机制，涉及网络毒理学和分子对接，但核心是毒理学而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Gossypol acetic acid (GAA), a natural product obtained from the cottonseed, has various bioactivities, including antiviral, anti-tumor and anti-inflammatory properties, among others. However, the potential intestinal toxicity of GAA is poorly studied. Here, the intestinal toxicity and the underlying mechanism were investigated in vivo using zebrafish and network toxicology. After exposure from 3 days post fertilization (dpf) to 6 dpf, GAA could notably affect the zebrafish gut barrier by reducing the microvilli and goblet cells, and subsequently affected the intestinal function, including decreasing the intestinal peristalsis and peristalsis number, endocytic capacity. In addition, GAA promoted the intestinal infiltration of neutrophil cells and cell death in the intestine. Furthermore, the mechanism study by network toxicology, molecular docking and RT-qPCR, showed that GAA could affect lipid metabolism, redox balance, apoptosis, inflammation and pyroptosis by regulating PPAR/NLRP3/GSDMD pathways. Taken together, these results will help to deeply understand GAA's harmful effects and underlying mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 醋酸棉酚（GAA）是一种从棉籽中提取的天然产物，具有多种生物活性，包括抗病毒、抗肿瘤和抗炎等。然而，关于GAA潜在的肠道毒性研究尚不充分。本研究利用斑马鱼和网络毒理学在体内探讨了其肠道毒性及潜在机制。从受精后3天（dpf）至6 dpf暴露后，GAA能显著影响斑马鱼肠道屏障，表现为减少微绒毛和杯状细胞，进而影响肠道功能，包括降低肠道蠕动及蠕动次数、内吞能力。此外，GAA促进了肠道中性粒细胞浸润和肠道细胞死亡。进一步通过网络毒理学、分子对接和RT-qPCR的机制研究表明，GAA通过调控PPAR/NLRP3/GSDMD通路，影响脂质代谢、氧化还原平衡、细胞凋亡、炎症和焦亡。综上所述，这些结果将有助于深入理解GAA的有害效应及其潜在机制。
